youtube.aciklama: With insert earphones, sound travels from the transducer to the ear through a thin tube, adding a delay of about 0.9 milliseconds. Tests measured in milliseconds, such as the auditory brainstem response (ABR), take this delay into account; in sound field testing, one meter between the loudspeaker and the head means a delay of about 3 milliseconds.
